subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should maintainers require full-runner or gateway proof before accepting this current-attempt replay metadata and server_error retry-routing change?
rationale: The code shape appears sound, but the remaining merge blockers are proof sufficiency and acceptance of a compatibility-sensitive attempt-result field plus provider retry ordering.

options.title: Require full-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, gateway logs, or an artifact showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate side effects before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: Maintainers can decide the predicate transcript and fault-injected tests are enough and own the remaining runtime-proof risk.

options.title: Pause for contract redesign
options.body: If the optional attempt-result field is not the desired harness contract, pause this PR and request a different current-attempt side-effect signal.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, gateway logs, or an artifact showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate side effects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the strongest current-source routing candidate from blame and GitHub commit metadata on the exact retry and attempt-result surfaces.
